name: Upper-Body Warm-up
cues: 30 s arm circles, forwards then backwards
30 s shoulder-blade squeezes: pull shoulders back and down, hold 2 s, release
30 s cat-cow on hands and knees
10 slow, easy incline push-ups against a table or wall
30 s wrist circles and gentle wrist stretches
mistakes: Rushing: this warms you up, it shouldn't tire you out

name: Lower-Body Warm-up
cues: 30 s marching in place with high knees
10 front-to-back leg swings per leg, holding a wall
10 hip circles in each direction
10 slow good mornings: hands on hips, hinge forward at the hips with a flat back
10 slow half squats
mistakes: Rushing: this warms you up, it shouldn't tire you out
Swinging legs so hard it pulls

name: Incline Push-up
cues: Hands on a sturdy table or counter edge, slightly wider than your shoulders
Walk your feet back until your body is one straight line from head to heels
Lower your chest to the edge with elbows about 45° from your body
Press back up to straight arms
mistakes: Elbows flaring straight out to the sides

name: Push-up
cues: Hands under your shoulders, slightly wider, fingers spread
Squeeze your glutes and brace your abs so your body is a straight line
Lower until your chest is about a fist from the floor, elbows about 45°
Push the floor away to full lockout
mistakes: Half reps: not going low enough

name: Decline Push-up
cues: Feet on a chair or sofa seat, hands on the floor slightly wider than your shoulders
Keep one straight line from head to heels
Lower your upper chest toward the floor, elbows about 45°
Press to full lockout
mistakes: Hips sagging (the decline makes this easier to do)
Using a surface that can slide

name: Archer Push-up
cues: Hands very wide, fingers turned slightly out
Lower toward one hand while the other arm straightens out to the side
Press back to the middle, then switch sides
Reps count per side
mistakes: Bending the straight arm to cheat

name: Pike Push-up
cues: Start in a push-up, then walk your feet in and lift your hips high into an upside-down V
Bend your elbows to lower the top of your head toward the floor just in front of your hands
Press back up, keeping your hips high
mistakes: Dropping your hips so it becomes a regular push-up

name: Elevated Pike Push-up
cues: Feet on a chair, hands on the floor, hips stacked high over your shoulders
Lower the top of your head toward the floor in front of your hands
Press back up until your arms are straight
mistakes: Lowering too fast and bumping your head

name: Dumbbell Floor Press
cues: Lie on your back, knees bent, a dumbbell in each hand above your chest
Lower until your upper arms touch the floor, elbows about 45°
Pause briefly, then press straight up
mistakes: Bouncing your elbows off the floor
Letting the dumbbells drift toward your face

name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
cues: Sit or stand tall with dumbbells at shoulder height
Brace your abs (and squeeze your glutes if standing)
Press overhead until your arms are straight, biceps near your ears
Lower under control back to shoulder height
mistakes: Arching your lower back to push the weight up
Pressing the weights forward instead of up

name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
cues: Stand tall, light dumbbells at your sides, a slight bend in your elbows
Raise your arms out to the sides until they're level with your shoulders
Lower slowly, taking about 2 seconds
mistakes: Shrugging your shoulders up to your ears

name: Chair Dip (Bent Knees)
cues: Hands on the edge of a sturdy chair behind you, fingers pointing forward
Feet flat, knees bent at 90°, hips close to the chair
Bend your elbows straight back to lower until your upper arms are about parallel to the floor
Press back up to straight arms
mistakes: Going too deep: stop if the front of your shoulder hurts
Using a chair that can roll or tip

name: Chair Dip (Straight Legs)
cues: Hands on the edge of a sturdy chair behind you, fingers pointing forward
Legs straight, heels on the floor
Bend your elbows straight back until your upper arms are about parallel to the floor
Press back up to straight arms
mistakes: Going too deep: stop if the front of your shoulder hurts
Using a chair that can roll or tip

name: Dumbbell Overhead Triceps Extension
cues: Hold one dumbbell with both hands overhead, arms straight
Keeping your elbows pointing forward, lower the weight behind your head
Straighten your arms to lift it back up

name: Dumbbell Bent-Over Row
cues: Hold the dumbbells and hinge at the hips until your torso is about 45°, knees soft, back flat
Pull the dumbbells toward your lower ribs, squeezing your shoulder blades together
Lower slowly until your arms are straight
mistakes: Jerking the weight up with your hips

name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row
cues: One hand and knee on a chair or sofa, other foot on the floor, back flat
Pull the dumbbell toward your hip, elbow close to your body
Lower until your arm is straight. Reps count per side
mistakes: Shrugging instead of pulling with your back

name: Seated Band Row
cues: Sit with legs straight, band looped around your feet, one end in each hand
Sit tall and pull the ends to your belly, elbows close to your body
Squeeze your shoulder blades together for a second, then release slowly

name: Door-Frame Row
cues: Stand in an open doorway, feet close to the frame, and grip both sides of a solid frame at chest height
Lean back with straight arms, body in a straight line
Pull your chest toward the frame by driving your elbows back
Lower slowly. Step your feet further in to make it harder
mistakes: Using a weak or loose door frame: test it first
Bending at the hips instead of keeping a straight body

name: Superman
cues: Lie face down with your arms stretched overhead
Lift your arms, chest and legs a few centimetres off the floor
Hold for 2 seconds, then lower slowly
mistakes: Cranking your neck up: keep looking at the floor

name: Prone Y-T-W Raise
cues: Lie face down with your forehead on a folded towel
Lift your arms into a Y shape, thumbs up, hold 2 s, lower
Repeat in a T shape, then a W shape with elbows bent. One Y-T-W is one rep
mistakes: Lifting with your lower back instead of your shoulder blades

name: Reverse Snow Angel
cues: Lie face down, arms by your sides, palms down, arms lifted slightly off the floor
Sweep your arms in a wide arc overhead, keeping them off the floor
Sweep back to your sides. That's one rep
mistakes: Resting your arms on the floor between reps

name: Band Pull-Apart
cues: Hold a band in front of you at shoulder height, hands shoulder-width apart, arms straight
Pull the band apart until it touches your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades
Return slowly

name: Dumbbell Reverse Fly
cues: Hinge forward until your torso is nearly parallel to the floor, light dumbbells hanging down
With a slight bend in your elbows, raise your arms out to the sides
Squeeze your shoulder blades at the top, then lower slowly

name: Dumbbell Biceps Curl
cues: Stand tall, dumbbells at your sides, palms facing forward
Keeping your elbows pinned to your sides, curl the weights up to your shoulders
Lower slowly all the way down

name: Dumbbell Hammer Curl
cues: Stand tall, dumbbells at your sides, palms facing each other
Keeping your elbows pinned, curl the weights up with palms still facing in
Lower slowly all the way down

name: Band Biceps Curl
cues: Stand on the middle of the band, one end in each hand, palms forward
Keeping your elbows pinned, curl your hands up to your shoulders
Lower slowly against the band's pull
mistakes: Letting the band yank your arms down

name: Chair Squat
cues: Stand in front of a sturdy chair, feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly out
Push your hips back and bend your knees to lightly touch the seat. Don't sit down
Drive through your whole foot to stand up tall

name: Bodyweight Squat
cues: Feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly out, arms forward for balance
Sit your hips back and down until your thighs are at least parallel to the floor
Keep your chest up and knees tracking over your toes
Stand up by pushing the floor away

name: Bulgarian Split Squat
cues: Stand about two steps in front of a chair and rest the top of your back foot on the seat
Lower straight down until your front thigh is about parallel to the floor
Push through your front heel to stand. Reps count per side
mistakes: Standing too close to the chair

name: Dumbbell Goblet Squat
cues: Hold one dumbbell upright against your chest
Feet shoulder-width apart; sit down between your heels, elbows inside your knees
Keep your chest up and stand by pushing the floor away

name: Reverse Lunge
cues: Stand tall, then step one foot back
Lower until both knees are bent about 90°, back knee just above the floor
Push through your front heel to return. Reps count per side

name: Glute Bridge
cues: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat and hip-width apart
Squeeze your glutes and lift your hips until your body is straight from shoulders to knees
Pause for 1 second, then lower slowly
mistakes: Arching your lower back at the top
Pushing through your toes instead of your heels

name: Single-Leg Glute Bridge
cues: Lie on your back, one knee bent with the foot flat, the other leg straight in the air
Drive through the planted heel to lift your hips level
Pause for 1 second, then lower slowly. Reps count per side

name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
cues: Stand with dumbbells in front of your thighs, knees slightly bent
Push your hips back, sliding the weights down your legs with a flat back
Stop when you feel a strong hamstring stretch, around mid-shin
Squeeze your glutes to stand back up
mistakes: Bending your knees so much it becomes a squat

name: Calf Raise
cues: Stand on the edge of a step, holding a wall for balance
Lower your heels below the step
Rise onto the balls of your feet as high as you can and pause for 1 second
mistakes: Only moving through a short range

name: Single-Leg Calf Raise
cues: Stand on one foot on the edge of a step, holding a wall
Lower your heel below the step
Rise as high as you can and pause for 1 second. Reps count per side
mistakes: Only moving through a short range

name: Dead Bug
cues: Lie on your back, arms pointing at the ceiling, knees bent 90° above your hips
Press your lower back into the floor
Slowly extend the opposite arm and leg toward the floor, then return. Alternate sides
mistakes: Lower back lifting off the floor

name: Lying Leg Raise
cues: Lie on your back, legs straight, hands under your hips
Press your lower back down and raise your legs to vertical
Lower slowly, stopping before your lower back arches

name: Crunch
cues: Lie on your back, knees bent, fingertips at your temples
Curl your shoulders off the floor by squeezing your abs
Lower slowly
mistakes: Coming all the way up (that's a sit-up)

name: Bicycle Crunch
cues: Lie on your back, fingertips at your temples, knees lifted
Bring one elbow toward the opposite knee while the other leg straightens
Switch sides in a slow pedalling motion. Each side counts as a rep
